================================================================================
COMPREHENSIVE EXPERIMENT RESULTS AND ANALYSIS REPORT
================================================================================

1. EXECUTIVE OVERVIEW
----------------------------------------
This document contains an exhaustive record of all experiments conducted, models evaluated, and metrics recorded during the execution of the generative framework. The objective of this framework was to synthesize tabular data representing aerospace structural designs while strictly adhering to the underlying physical boundaries and empirical distributions of the real dataset.

2. AGGREGATE STATISTICS
----------------------------------------
Total Model Architectures Tested: 6
Total Individual Trials/Runs: 72
Best Performing Model: Empirical
Highest Composite Score: 0.9969
Best Configuration: Seed=11, Size=5000

3. EXPERIMENTAL METHODOLOGY AND PIPELINE
----------------------------------------
The experimental pipeline involved several key phases:
Phase 1: Data Preprocessing and Boundary Extraction
 - The empirical aerospace dataset was analyzed to extract absolute minimum and maximum bounds for all physical features (e.g., Modulus of Elasticity, Tensile Strength, Density).
Phase 2: Generative Model Training
 - Six distinct models were evaluated: Empirical (baseline copying), KDE (Kernel Density Estimation), GMM (Gaussian Mixture Model), Copula (Gaussian Copula), TabuDiff (Tabular Diffusion), and MaskedPredictor.
 - Each model was tested across three random seeds (11, 42, 123) and four generation sizes (300, 600, 1000, 5000).
Phase 3: Deep Evaluation and Metric Computation
 - Generated datasets were evaluated across four primary pillars: Physics Consistency, Statistical Similarity, ML Utility (TSTR), and Privacy Detectability.
Phase 4: Explainability and Artifact Generation
 - The pipeline aggressively logged all trials and generated visual comparisons (KDE overlays, Correlation matrices) to provide visual proof of generative fidelity.
